rows.en: ＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿００１Hello. Could I bother you for￥a moment? It won't take long.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿００２It's about your ranking...￥If you just leave it alone, I￥think it can only end badly...
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿００３Of course, I imagine you feel at￥least a little worried about￥where you stand, too...
Of course I do.
No, not really.
Of course I do.
No, not really.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿００４I see. Well, that's good, then.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿００５But if you feel that way, you￥should've tried harder from the￥start...
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿００６I can't believe you'd say that￥with a straight face!
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿００７Do you have a clear purpose--￥"something you want to do"￥once you get to Elan?
Of course I do.
I haven't decided yet.
Of course I do.
I haven't decided yet.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿００８Saying it is the easy part.＝＠０８５＿００９But I just don't see you working￥hard toward that goal.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿０１０Then what exactly are you here￥for? This isn't a playground,￥you know!
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿０１１You've really disappointed me...￥If you still have enough pride￥left to get angry at my words...
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿０１２...then I'd have thought you￥could still start over.＝＠０８５＿０１３Well, maybe that's beyond you.＝＠０８５＿０１４We'll all be watching to see￥what you do next.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿０１５Well, sorry to have bothered￥you. Goodbye...
